provenance.selection: Predeclared namespace-SHA256 order; no model/tokenizer/score used
provenance.split_policy: Alternate selected article hash order into development(dev) and sealed validation(test); all source paragraphs/questions for an article stay together. Never select or change split by retrieval result.
provenance.article_component_policy: Exactly1source document per article per view; gold-source bootstrap units are full articles
provenance.transformation: One.txtsource document per article:3selected unmodified source paragraphs in original upstream order, joined by2newlines; no title prefix. Under64article primary use2paragraphs instead.
provenance.answer_policy: Sort by SHA256(namespace + upstream question ID), ID tiebreaker; select first3eligible normalized unique question texts. Use first nonempty answer annotation with exact matching character offset; convert to UTF8source bytes after article rendering.
limitations: SQuAD/Wikipedia may overlap model pretraining; procedural tuning blindness does not imply pretraining novelty
Question annotations are independently authored, exact short answers are not independently audited complete supporting-evidence sets
Synthetic article rendering introduces headings/joins and transformation bias; text view is paired control
32article fallback yields16articleclustersper split; descriptive intervals and no universal leadership claim
